title: Idea and voice
slide_intent: Teach writers to describe an agent’s financial action in terms a tired person can check. A specific amount, reason or limit helps the reader decide whether anything needs their attention.
strategic_value: Halfkey can give its agent a consistent, accountable voice. The Done, Ask and Stopped examples show how the tone can stay calm even when the outcome changes.
demonstration: A headline about fatigue introduces a story, four personality traits and four speaking rules. Three paired examples contrast preferred and discouraged wording for the same event.
practical_value: A writer can revise a stopped-request message by naming who asked, what they wanted and which limit stopped the action.
